question: Who among the following was appointed as the new Economic Affairs Secretary in April 2021?
solution:
The correct answer is **__Ajay Seth__**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The government has reshuffled the top bureaucracy in the Finance Ministry, shifting Economic Affairs Secretary Tarun Bajaj to the Revenue Department.
 
• Bajaj has been handling the additional charge of the Revenue Department after Ajay Bhushan Pandey retired in February 2021.
 
• 1987 batch Karnataka cadre civil servant Ajay Seth__ has been appointed as the new Economic Affairs Secretary.
